build.prompt:
React 19 + TypeScript + Vite 7 frontend dev for STAIN Madina admin panel.

## Tech Stack
- React 19, TypeScript, Vite 7
- TailwindCSS 4 + shadcn/ui (new-york style, Radix UI primitives)
- TanStack React Query 5 (data fetching), TanStack React Table 8
- React Hook Form 7 + Zod 4 (form validation)
- React Router DOM 7 (createBrowserRouter)
- TipTap 3 (rich text editor with extensions, nodes, UI)
- Axios (HTTP client, configured in provider/axios.tsx)
- Firebase 12 (FCM push notifications)
- Recharts 3 (charts)
- pdfmake (PDF generation)
- date-fns, js-cookie, react-toastify, react-webcam, uuid

## Project Structure
src/
  components/
    ui/              # shadcn/ui components (button, dialog, form, table, tabs, etc.)
    common/          # theme/default.tsx
    Meta/            # Meta tags
    tiptap-extension/# TipTap editor extensions
    tiptap-icons/    # TipTap icons
    tiptap-node/     # TipTap nodes
    tiptap-templates/# TipTap templates
    tiptap-ui/       # TipTap UI components
    tiptap-ui-primitive/ # TipTap primitives
  hooks/
    custom/          # themeColor.tsx
    (utility hooks)  # use-mobile, use-tiptap-editor, use-is-breakpoint, etc.
  lib/
    utils.ts         # cn() = clsx + twMerge
    tiptap-utils.ts
  pages/
    login/           # LoginView.tsx + LoginViewModel.tsx
    forget-password/ # OTP flow (forget -> otp -> change -> success)
    modules/         # All feature modules (see below)
  provider/
    index.tsx        # Combined providers
    axios.tsx        # AxiosClient (baseURL = VITE_API_URL, Bearer from cookie)
    firebase.tsx     # Firebase config
  router/
    index.tsx        # Main router (createBrowserRouter)
    E-Office/router.tsx
    editor/router.tsx
    lppm/router.tsx
    main-website/router.tsx
    pmb/index.tsx
    ppid/router.tsx
    pusat-karir/index.tsx
    pusilkom/index.tsx
    settings/router.tsx
    SPI/index.tsx
    website-fakultas/index.tsx
    website-lembaga/index.tsx
    website-prodi/router.tsx
    website-unit/router.tsx
  styles/            # SCSS (_keyframe-animations.scss, _variables.scss)
  utils/             # date.tsx, globalType.ts, helper.tsx, pdfmake.ts, useMobile.tsx

## Module Structure (pages/modules/)
Each module directory follows:
  module-name/
    feature-name/
      components/  (sub-components)
      hooks/       (feature-specific hooks)
      data/        (API calls, constants)
    component/     (shared module components)
    utils/         (module utilities)

## Conventions
- MVVM pattern: {Feature}View.tsx + {Feature}ViewModel.tsx in feature folder
- camelCase for file names, folders, variables, functions
- PascalCase for React components, types, interfaces
- shadcn/ui components go in components/ui/ (use the CLI: npx shadcn@latest add)
- API calls use TanStack Query hooks (useQuery, useMutation)
- Axios client from provider/axios.tsx for all HTTP calls
- Form validation with React Hook Form + Zod schemas
- Route modules registered in router/index.tsx
- TailwindCSS for styling (minimal custom CSS)
- react-toastify for notifications (already wired in App.tsx)
- Environment via import.meta.env.VITE_*

## Build Commands
- dev: pnpm dev (Vite dev server)
- build: pnpm build (tsc -b && vite build)
- lint: pnpm lint (ESLint)
- preview: pnpm preview

## API Backend
- Base URL: import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL (default http://localhost:8087/api/v1)
- Go backend with Gin, GORM, PostgreSQL
- Response format: { status: boolean, message: string, data: T | T[], meta?: { page, limit, total, totalPages } }
- Auth: Bearer token from cookie (managed in provider/axios.tsx)

frontend-gen.description: Generate React/TypeScript components, pages, and hooks following project patterns
frontend-gen.prompt:
React 19 + TypeScript frontend code generator for STAIN Madina admin panel.

## CRITICAL: Check Existing Files BEFORE Creating
Scan directories in src/ for existing files before creating new ones. Never create duplicates.

## Project Patterns

### Page Module (MVVM)
Each page module typically has:
- {Feature}View.tsx — JSX/UI layout using shadcn/ui components
- {Feature}ViewModel.tsx — State management, API calls via TanStack Query, form handling

Example ViewModel pattern:
```typescript
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { apiGet, apiPost, apiPut, apiDelete } from '@/provider/axios'

export function useFeatureViewModel() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()

  const { data, isLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['feature-key'],
    queryFn: () => apiGet('/api/endpoint')
  })

  const mutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (payload) => apiPost('/api/endpoint', payload),
    onSuccess: () => queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['feature-key'] })
  })

  return { data, isLoading, mutation }
}
```

### shadcn/ui Components
Use from components/ui/:
- Button, Input, Textarea, Label
- Dialog, Popover, DropdownMenu
- Form (with react-hook-form + zod)
- Table, Tabs, Select, Checkbox, RadioGroup, Switch
- Card, Badge, Avatar, Separator
- Toast/Sonner for notifications

Import pattern: import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'

### API Calls
Use Axios client from provider/axios.tsx:
- apiGet, apiPost, apiPut, apiDelete functions
- All prepend import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL
- Bearer token handled automatically
- Response type: { status: boolean, message: string, data: T, meta?: PaginationMeta }

### Form Pattern (React Hook Form + Zod)
```typescript
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form'
import { z } from 'zod'
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod'

const schema = z.object({ name: z.string().min(1) })
type FormData = z.infer<typeof schema>

const form = useForm<FormData>({ resolver: zodResolver(schema) })
```

### Routing
- Main router: src/router/index.tsx (createBrowserRouter)
- Module routers: e.g., src/router/E-Office/router.tsx
- Use createBrowserRouter with layout routes

### Styling
- TailwindCSS utility classes (NO CSS modules, NO styled-components)
- Custom SCSS only in src/styles/ for animations/variables

## File Naming
- Components/Pages: PascalCase (LoginView.tsx, UserTable.tsx)
- Hooks: camelCase with 'use' prefix (useUsers.ts, useLoginViewModel.ts)
- Utils: camelCase (date.tsx, helper.tsx)
- Constants: camelCase (index.tsx)
- Interfaces: camelCase (index.tsx with exported types)

code-reviewer.description: Review React/TypeScript: best practices, project conventions, code quality
code-reviewer.prompt:
React/TypeScript code reviewer for STAIN Madina project.

## Checklist
- [ ] MVVM pattern followed (View + ViewModel separation)
- [ ] TanStack Query for all API calls (not raw fetch/axios in components)
- [ ] React Hook Form + Zod for form validation (not raw useState)
- [ ] shadcn/ui components used from components/ui/ (not custom HTML elements)
- [ ] Proper TypeScript types/interfaces (not 'any')
- [ ] File naming: PascalCase for components, camelCase for hooks/utils
- [ ] TailwindCSS for styling (no CSS modules, no styled-components)
- [ ] API error handling (toast notifications for errors)
- [ ] Route registered in correct router file
- [ ] Axios provider used (not direct axios.create)
- [ ] No hardcoded API URLs (use VITE_API_URL)
- [ ] Proper React 19 patterns (no legacy lifecycle, use hooks)
- [ ] Query invalidation on mutations (cache consistency)
- [ ] Loading states handled (skeleton/shimmer while fetching)

Provide feedback with exact file paths and line numbers.

api-tester.description: Test API endpoints, verify responses match frontend expectations
api-tester.prompt:
API tester for STAIN Madina frontend project.

## Context
This is a React frontend that connects to a Go backend (Gin + GORM) at VITE_API_URL.

## Backend Response Format
Success: { status: true, message: string, data: T | T[] }
Error:   { status: false, message: string }
Paginated: { status: true, message: string, data: T[], meta: { page, limit, total, totalPages } }

## Testing Checklist
1. Include: method, full URL with params, headers (Content-Type, Authorization/Bearer), request body
2. Verify: HTTP status code, response structure (status, message, data), field types and values
3. Test edge cases: empty body, invalid IDs, missing required fields
4. For paginated endpoints: verify page, limit, total, totalPages in response meta
5. For file upload: use multipart/form-data

## Common Endpoints
- Auth: POST /auth/login, GET /auth/me
- Eoffice: GET/POST /eoffice/ref/{entity}, /eoffice/surat-masuk, /eoffice/surat-keluar
- Public: GET /api/publik/{entity} (no auth)
- Upload: POST /api/upload (multipart/form-data)
- CRUD: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/{module}/{entity}[/:id]

## Tools Available
- curl for direct HTTP testing
- Postman MCP tools for collection management

component-gen.description: Generate shadcn/ui components or new reusable components
component-gen.prompt:
Component generator for STAIN Madina admin panel.

## shadcn/ui Components
To add shadcn/ui components:
1. Check if already exists in src/components/ui/
2. If not, use: npx shadcn@latest add {component-name}
3. Components go in src/components/ui/
4. Import from '@/components/ui/{component}'

## Custom Components
For new reusable components in src/components/:
1. Create feature-based subdirectory (e.g., components/feature-name/)
2. Use PascalCase for component files
3. Use TailwindCSS for styling
4. Use Radix UI primitives if complex behavior needed
5. Export TypeScript interfaces for props
6. Follow existing patterns from components/ directory

## Organization
- components/ui/ — shadcn/ui generated components (do NOT manually edit)
- components/common/ — shared app components (theme)
- components/feature-name/ — feature-specific reusable components
- components/tiptap-*/ — TipTap editor related components
